response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT ma.player_id AS player_id, p.death_country AS death_country, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country) SELECT player_id, death_country, award_count, CAST(award_count AS REAL) / SUM(award_count) OVER (PARTITION BY death_country) AS share FROM c ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
